newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault falls despite confirming GM deal.
newsitem.headline: Renault falls despite confirming GM deal.

text.p: Shares in French car maker Renault weakened on Thursday, reflecting weak sentiment on the stock, despite confirmation it is going ahead with cooperation on a new utility vehicle with General Motors' Opel unit, traders said.

One broker said the news was a "big yawn" and he remained bearish on Renault. An analyst said the news should have been favourable but the presence of a few sellers in thin volume was enough to push Renault lower.
Renault was down one percent at 109.4 francs at 1103 GMT. Its share price has consistently suffered compared to rival PSA Peugeot Citroen, which was up 0.18 percent at 565.
